Name resolution: explicit certificateName override → discovered asset name round-tripped in virtualServerName (used verbatim, so the new version lands on the existing object) →

Data plane only: ClientSecretCredential against the vault URL; no Azure Resource Manager, works across subscriptions and tenants
Subject normalised for Azure: emailAddress moved to the SAN, RDN order kept, CN-only retry if Azure rejects the DN
Explicit Netty HTTP client: honours JVM proxy settings, tolerates TLS-inspecting egress, avoids ServiceLoader lookups inside the shaded JAR
Certificate object: same name, new version
No duplicate object, no rebinding: consumers keep referencing the same certificate name.
